cause: Training/serving transformation skew on f2: the training pipeline applies a log1p transform (training f2 = ln(1 + raw)), but the online serving path serves the raw untransformed value. Verified on Databricks by joining the two tables on entity_id: avg |train_f2 - ln(1 + serve_f2)| = 2.4e-7 (float rounding), while f1, f3, f4, f5 match exactly (mean abs diff 0, corr 1.0).
